_doc: BOOST framework parameters. Set activeProfile to match the SESSION model:
'fable'  -> Claude Fable 5 session (DEFAULT): team mode - plan/ideate on Fable, implement on Sonnet 5, code-check on Opus 4.8
'opus'   -> Claude Opus 4.8 standalone (smaller gap to frontier: lighter redundancy)
'sonnet' -> Claude Sonnet 5 standalone (bigger gap: more candidates, more votes, smaller steps)
mode 'single' keeps every agent/workflow on the session model (the standalone-boost guarantee).
mode 'team' routes roles to different models via the Agent tool's model option and workflows' args.model:
roles.plan   - who plans/ideates/synthesizes (the session main loop; never delegated)
roles.build  - model for boost-builder implementation agents
roles.review - model for boost-critic / boost-verifier / adversarial-review agents
Skills read this file when invoked; CLAUDE.md requires reading it before the first T1+ task of the session.
Workflows can NOT read this file - the invoking skill passes the values via args (see each skill's invocation template).
Parameter meanings:
planCandidates    - independent plan/design candidates generated for T2+ tasks
judges            - judge-panel size when scoring candidates (T3 / wide solution space)
refuteVotes       - independent skeptic votes per finding/claim in adversarial verification
surviveQuorum     - a finding/claim is CONFIRMED only if >= this many votes say it holds
reviewLenses      - dimensions every T2+ diff is reviewed under
maxUnverifiedSteps- max consecutive edit steps before a mandatory verification checkpoint
researchAngles    - parallel search angles for research questions
doubleDerivation  - which conclusions must be derived twice via independent routes
hardStepEffort    - reasoning effort passed to boost workflows as args.effort for their finder/judge/skeptic stages (final synthesis always runs at xhigh)
